title: Place images
goal: Each place keeps its photos locally
acceptance: Attach images to a place; thumbnails; files in the git-ignored data folder
GPS and other EXIF metadata stripped on import; tests with an invented image
privacy: Neutral, invented test data only; no owner places, home address, photos, routes or API keys in Git.
escalation: A material scope or effort increase goes to the owner

prs.note: content-sniffed place image upload, size limit, EXIF/GPS stripping and thumbnail component

effort.basis: Implemented 2026-11-25 in PR #7; verification is green CI on PR #7 and merge.

review: 2026-11-26 Claude (Opus, fresh worktree) reviewed PR #7 written by Gemini. Fixed (test first): an upload announcing a Content-Length over 5 MB is now refused with 413 before its body is read. Added tests: a real decodable JPEG with a well-formed GPS EXIF IFD (stripped, scan data kept; also checked with macOS ImageIO: GPS present before, absent after, image still decodes), deleting a place unlinks its files, and image names that would leave the folder answer 404.
